Which statement explains why graphite is used as a lubricant?
A
Each carbon atom in graphite forms three bonds.
B
The bonding in graphite is covalent.
C
The carbon atoms are arranged in hexagons.
D
There are weak forces of attraction between the layers of carbon atoms.
